topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Walking down memory lane, each step lightly echoing through the hallways, I pause at the familiar doorway. The scent of chalk and old books whisks me back. There she is, her eyes as bright as the first day, my child, ready to learn. Miss Jenkins greets her with the same warm smile, a tapestry of patience and wisdom. I see my own past reflected in her eyes, the same kindness, the same invitations to discovery. My steps are slow as I watch from afar, content in the knowing that these walls, these stories, are now hers to carry. Time has turned a circle, and in this moment, everything feels both new and deeply right.
